  • Paṭhamavagga Chapter One

Sumanattheragāthā Sumana (1st)

“Yaṁ patthayāno dhammesu, My mentor helped me to learn, upajjhāyo anuggahi; hoping I would practice those teachings. Amataṁ abhikaṅkhantaṁ, Aspiring to freedom from death, kataṁ kattabbakaṁ mayā. I’ve done what had to be done.

Anuppatto sacchikato, I’ve realized the Dhamma, sayaṁ dhammo anītiho; witnessing it for myself, not based on legends. Visuddhañāṇo nikkaṅkho, With purified knowledge, free of doubt, byākaromi tavantike. I declare it in your presence.

Pubbenivāsaṁ jānāmi, I know my past lives, dibbacakkhu visodhitaṁ; my clairvoyance is purified, Sadattho me anuppatto, I’ve realized my heart’s goal, kataṁ buddhassa sāsanaṁ. and fulfilled the Buddha’s instructions.

Appamattassa me sikkhā, Being diligent in the training, sussutā tava sāsane; I learned your teachings well. Sabbe me āsavā khīṇā, All my defilements are ended; natthi dāni punabbhavo. now there’ll be no more future lives.

Anusāsi maṁ ariyavatā, You advised me in noble observances; Anukampi anuggahi; sympathetic, you helped teach me. Amogho tuyhamovādo, Your instruction was not in vain— Antevāsimhi sikkhito”ti. I, your pupil, am fully trained.

… Sumano thero ….
